Subject: Sandbox walkthrough — proposed times and prep

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to hear how Finova is planning to pilot the claims summarization flow. Per our conversation, I wanted to get a hands-on sandbox session on the calendar so your engineers can
- see the Redwood Console routing and credentialing,
- walk through the API enablement (key exchange + example requests), and
- run a short end-to-end test against the sandbox model variant.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-06-22 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-06-23 13:00–14:00
- Thu 2026-06-24 09:00–10:00

If those don't work, let me know two 1-hour windows that do and we can accommodate. I attached a brief agenda and the provisioning doc so your infra team can prepare credentials in advance.

Who should I include on the invite from your side? I’ll have Jordan (solutions engineering) join to run the live debugging and Ava will do the Console walkthrough.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Quick notes for Samir to prep (also attached):
- API endpoints we’ll hit: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, and a short reranking example used in the demo.
- Default rate-limit for sandbox: 60 rpm, 8 concurrent connections. If you expect higher concurrency Samir, tell Jordan and we’ll temporarily open a higher burst cap for the session.

Jordan will host the session and walk the SDK snippets; Ava will lead the Console routing and creds. I’ll send the calendar invite momentarily.

Thanks — looking forward.
